 "rationale": "Two gain stages give about 74 dB using moderate L. GBW = gm1/Cc ≈ 39 MHz from a 30 uA tail at gm/Id 13 with Cc = 0.8 pF. A 110 uA second stage (gm7 ≈ 1.3 mS) puts p2 above 2×GBW, and Rz > 1/gm7 adds an LHP zero. All bias currents mirror directly from ibias. Total current is 10 + 30 + 110 = 150 uA, about 270 uW. The class-A CS output swings from vdsat to VDD - vdsat, about 1.5 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),     # input pair
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),
    "Itail": (30e-6, 20e-6, 40e-6),
    "gmidp": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),     # PMOS mirror load + M7 (same density -> low systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (0.7, 0.4, 1.2),
    "I7":    (110e-6, 80e-6, 125e-6),
    "gmidn": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),     # NMOS current sources (ref, tail, M8)
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Cc":    (0.8e-12, 0.4e-12, 1.5e-12),
    "kz":    (1.6, 1.0, 3.0),       # Rz = kz / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vdd = 1.8
    It, I7 = p["Itail"], p["I7"]
    Id1 = It / 2

    # devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=0.55, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Id1, vds=0.9)
    m3d = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Id1, vds=m3.vgs)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=mr.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm
    Cc = p["Cc"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp drives the out1 side -> non-inverting overall (CS 2nd stage inverts)
    n.dev("M1", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3d)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "nc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    Cout = CL + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    fp2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + C1 * Cout + Cout * Cc))
    dz = Rz - 1 / m7.gm
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fp2))
    if abs(dz) > 1e-9:
        fz = 1 / (2 * PI * Cc * abs(dz))
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fz)) * (1 if dz > 0 else -1)
    fpm = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fpm)) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (2 * fpm)))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (Cout + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew}
